title: The Earth that pulls everything down
why: Spin the Earth: gravity pulls every falling thing toward its middle, from every side.

title: The Moon, where things fall slower
why: Turn the Moon and spot its craters; its gravity is weaker, so a dropped feather and hammer fall gently.
credit: “moon” by RenderX, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab
